answer: Sybil resistance is a stake bond in a reputation escrow slashed when peers flag collusion. One identity needs 500 USDC locked for sixty days; forging ten thousand fakes ties up 5 million USDC plus ninety days of verification and each lost bond pays the honest attesters who flagged it. New epochs reset scrutiny, so the tide of clones keeps hitting fresh checks instead of a settled wall of trust. It is like painting a terrace: every forged identity adds pigment, but that pigment is real money forfeited on slashing, so cheating drains your wallet before it floods the room.
